# StarTruckerLogger v0.1.0-beta.1 — Compatibility Preview

> **Pre-release / testing build.** This release packages the current source on `master`. It does not include a compiled Windows executable.

## What's changed
- Target framework updated to **.NET 8 for Windows**.
- Explicit Windows Forms application entry point configured.
- Added an audit and development plan targeting Star Trucker v1.75.x.
- Updated project README, build instructions, and branch documentation.
- Continued support for the existing VTC website client and manual logging concepts.

## Still in development
- Real, verified capture of in-game delivery and courier events.
- Reliable compatibility with the latest game update.
- Automatic telemetry, event deduplication, and offline queueing.
- Hardening API authentication and validation.

## Experimental multiplayer
An independent **LAN/VPN VTC companion prototype** is available in the [experimental/lan-multiplayer branch](https://github.com/TTVytangelofhype/StarTruckerLogger/tree/experimental/lan-multiplayer). It exchanges status messages over a private network. **It is not in-game multiplayer**, and the multiplayer experiment is **not included in this master-branch pre-release**.

## Install / build
Download this release's source code or clone the tagged commit. On Windows, install the **.NET 8 SDK** and run:
```powershell
dotnet restore
dotnet build StarTruckerLogger.csproj -c Release
```
**A successful Windows build and game telemetry integration have not yet been verified.** Expect unfinished features.

Project by **TTVytangelofhype**. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Star Trucker's creators.
